html:
The Transnistria War was a short war in 1992 between Moldova and separatists on the east bank of the Dniester, backed by the Russian 14th Army, which left the region outside Moldovan control.

Transnistria had been part of the Soviet Moldavian republic since 1940, with many Russian and Ukrainian speakers and much of the republic's industry. Fearing union with Romania after independence, local leaders declared their own republic in 1990. Fighting peaked at Bender in June 1992, and about a thousand people died. A ceasefire left Russian troops as peacekeepers. Transnistria still runs as an unrecognised state with its own currency, and the conflict hangs over Moldova's path toward the European Union.
sum: The Transnistria War was a short war in 1992 between Moldova and separatists on the east bank of the Dniester, backed by the Russian 14th Army, which left the region outside Moldovan control.
